description.text: Main courses: Managerial Economics Marketing International Business Law Leadership and Management Communication Financial Management Strategic Management International Business Financial Market Accounting Data, Model and Decision Business Ethics and Social Responsibility Technical Innovation Organizational Behaviour Chinese Culture and Management Modern Sevices Management Operation Management MIS Thesis Defense

duration.text: The MBA at Hubei University is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 10416 USD/per year ￥ 75000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduate certificate of bachelor degree Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of bachelor degree

requirements.text: Applicants for Doctoral degree must have obtained Master’s Degree and be under the age of 40 and be healthy
